headline: Video: 9M-2026, BSI Books Net Profit of Rp6,13 Trillion
summary: Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) recorded a net profit of Rp6.13 trillion in the first nine months of 2026. The figure was reported in a CNBC Indonesia video.
why: Bank Syariah Indonesia is one of Indonesia's largest sharia-compliant banks, listed on the Jakarta Stock Exchange. Its quarterly results indicate the health of the country's Islamic banking sector.
original_headline: Video: 9M-2026, BSI Raup Laba Bersih Rp6,13 Triliun
